fields.description: What this role may do. Field picker - search Link-field values without the list or the full document (implied by Read). Export, import, print, share and reports are granted separately from Read and Edit; Share also needs Edit.

fields.label: Row condition
fields.description: Which rows this rule covers: field == user, field != 'value' or link_field.field == user. Empty - all rows.

fields.label: Hidden fields (comma-separated)
fields.description: Not shown to this role, and not changed, filtered or searched by.

fields.label: Read-only fields (comma-separated)
fields.description: Shown to this role but kept as they are once the document exists; a new document takes their value. A role that may change them wins.
